verdict.rationale: OpenCode is itself an AI coding agent, so it plays the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents via an official MCP server is a different product role. The evidence shows only client-side MCP support (adding external local/remote MCP servers). The `opencode serve` command exposes an OpenAPI HTTP server, not an MCP server, so nothing flips this axis to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
